description: This file contains unit tests for the auto_rebaseline command in the WebKitPy testing framework, specifically testing the behavior of the auto_rebaseline_unittest module, including test case setup, execution, and various scenarios of rebaselining tests.

classes.name: TestAutoRebaseline
classes.description: A unittest.TestCase subclass that tests the auto_rebaseline command's functionality, including setup, test scenarios, and execution flow.

methods.name: _write_test_file
methods.description: Helper method to write test contents to a specified file path within the test port.

methods.name: _execute_with_mock_options
methods.description: Helper method to execute the command with specified options, mocking authentication and dry run parameters.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, including mock build results and repository revision data.

methods.name: test_release_builders
methods.description: Tests the private method _release_builders to ensure it correctly identifies release build configurations.

methods.name: test_tests_to_rebaseline
methods.description: Tests the logic for determining which tests need to be rebaselined based on blame information.

methods.name: test_tests_to_rebaseline_over_limit
methods.description: Verifies behavior when the number of tests to rebaseline exceeds the maximum limit.

methods.name: test_commit_message
methods.description: Checks the correctness of the generated commit message for rebaselining.

methods.name: test_no_needs_rebaseline_lines
methods.description: Ensures no rebaseline actions are taken when no tests are marked for rebaseline.

methods.name: test_execute
methods.description: Simulates a full execution of the rebaseline process, verifying the sequence of commands and file modifications.

methods.name: test_execute_git_cl_hangs
methods.description: Tests behavior when the git cl command hangs, ensuring the process handles timeouts or interruptions.

methods.name: test_execute_test_passes_everywhere
methods.description: Verifies the process when tests pass on all builders, ensuring proper cleanup and command execution.

methods.name: test_execute_use_alternate_rebaseline_branch
methods.description: Tests rebaseline execution when using an alternate branch name.

methods.name: test_execute_stuck_on_alternate_rebaseline_branch
methods.description: Verifies behavior when the process is stuck on an alternate rebaseline branch.

methods.name: _basic_execute_test
methods.description: Helper method to run a standard execution scenario with specified expected commands and options.

methods.name: test_execute_with_rietveld_auth_refresh_token
methods.description: Tests the command execution with an Rietveld refresh token for authentication.

methods.name: test_execute_with_dry_run
methods.description: Verifies that no changes are made during a dry run.

methods.name: test_bot_revision_data
methods.description: Checks that the bot revision data is correctly retrieved.
